name: United Kingdom
notes: House of Commons: 650 seats, first-past-the-post. 2024 result: Labour 412 seats (33.8%, including Chorley - the Speaker Lindsay Hoyle counts as Labour), Conservatives 121 (23.7%), Liberal Democrats 72 (12.2%), SNP 9 (2.5%), Sinn Fein 7 (0.7%), Reform UK 5 (14.3%), Green 4 (6.8%), Plaid Cymru 4 (0.7%), DUP 5 (0.6%), SDLP 2 (0.3%), Alliance 1 (0.4%), UUP 1 (0.3%), TUV 1 (0.2%). The Northern Ireland parties have no GB/UK polling, so their seats hold the 2024 baseline. Next general election due no later than 15 August 2029.
